results.title: Gold: Sell the 4,160 Retest Before CPI?
results.description: • Macro Driver: Spot Gold trades under persistent distribution pressure around $4,153 on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, as global markets brace for today's supreme macroeconomic catalyst: the US September Consumer Price Index (CPI) report (08:30 AM ET). With US Treasury yields holding firm near multi-month highs and the US Dollar Index (DXY) consolidating in premium territory following hawkish policy signals from Fed officials, institutional capital remains defensive. Broad desks are positioning ahead of today's inflation print and tomorrow's PPI alongside Retail Sales data to price the next trajectory for the Fed's terminal rate. • Market Condition: Institutional order flow shows an active sell-side markdown within a well-defined Descending Channel. Following the impulsive rejection from the Overhead Supply Block (4,188 – 4,200) and the sequential BOS/CHoCH breaks, smart money is guiding price downward along the channel median line, preparing to sweep intermediate liquidity before testing macro discount arrays. Technical Context • Structure: Bearish Descending Channel / Markdown Cycle. On the 1H timeframe, Gold remains structurally confined beneath the descending channel ceiling originating from the 4,220 swing peak. After testing the channel midline, price is pressing into the Intermediate Demand Shelf (4,132.00 – 4,142.00). • Liquidity & Imbalance: Price is currently hovering at 4,153.30. The technical delivery roadmap points toward an initial intraday tap into the Intermediate Demand Shelf (4,132.00 – 4,142.00), followed by a corrective relief bounce to retest the broken channel median / Resistance Pivot (4,155.00 – 4,162.00). A confirmed bearish displacement from this relief wave will trigger the next impulsive expansion leg downward, slicing through local demand to sweep the Primary Discount Demand Base (4,105.00 – 4,115.00). Key Zones • Overhead Supply Block / Channel Ceiling (Upper Blue Box): 4,188.00 – 4,200.00 • Dynamic Channel Median Line: 4,150.00 – 4,160000 • Current Market Price: 4,153.30 • Intermediate Demand Shelf (Middle Blue Box): 4,132.00 – 4,142.00 • Primary Discount Demand Base (Lower Blue Box): 4,105.00 – 4,115.00 • Macro Invalidation Floor (Weak Low Swept): 4,066.79 Trading Plan (IF–THEN) • IF price taps the 4,132.00 – 4,142.00 Intermediate Demand Shelf and delivers a corrective relief bounce toward 4,155 – 4,162 AND validates lower-timeframe (M5/M15) bearish displacement/rejection -> THEN look to execute Short continuation setups, targeting 4,130 and expanding directly into the 4,105.00 – 4,115.00 Primary Discount Demand Base. • IF price confirms a decisive 1H candle close above 4,175 breaking out of the channel median -> THEN the immediate bearish markdown thesis is delayed, reopening rotation toward the 4,190 overhead supply zone. MMFLOW View • Bias: Pro-Trend Bearish Markdown within Channel. Buying into dropping momentum directly ahead of the US CPI release carries severe downside risk; our institutional mathematical edge favors shorting confirmed relief pullbacks beneath channel resistance to target the 4,110 primary discount demand floor. Are you selling the relief retest toward 4,110 ahead of today's CPI, or expecting the 4,135 demand shelf to trigger a full channel breakout?
